children: ICICI Securities's research report on Mahindra and Mahindra

Mahindra & Mahindra (M&M)’s reported EBITDAM of 11.7% was below our estimate. EBITM for both auto and farm undershot our expectation by 20–30bps. In the near term, the impact of RM inflation may continue to weigh on overall margins; however, management expects headwinds to ease during FY28. Demand trends in underlying auto industry continue to remain robust, while tractors are likely to see muted traction owing to rainfall deficit and drought condition in key regions. In the auto segment,

We envisage M&M’s healthy performance to continue, supported by strong traction for its models, capacity addition in the near term and new launches. Incremental impact of RM inflation, and response to upcoming launches remain key factors to watch. Retain BUY with an SoTP-based revised TP of INR 3,800 (vs. INR 3,700), implying 22x Sep’28E core EPS.
